sourcedFrom: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 (2025)
cleanIntro: Ruger’s field strip for the Security-380. It reads like the Security-9’s, with one number that is not the same — read step 5.

steps.title: Magazine out first
steps.action: Keep the pistol pointed in a safe direction, press the magazine latch and withdraw the magazine from the frame.
steps.prose: Feeding source, then chamber. Always that order.
steps.quote: Keep the pistol pointed in a safe direction. Press the magazine latch and withdraw the magazine from the frame
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 1, p.21
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Lock the slide back
steps.action: Pull the slide to the rear and lock it open by pushing upward on the slide stop.
steps.prose: The Lite Rack slide is deliberately easy to run — it still locks back the same way.
steps.quote: and lock it in the open
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 2, p.21

steps.title: Verify the chamber
steps.action: Inspect the chamber and verify that it is empty.
steps.quote: Inspect the chamber and verify that it is empty
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 3, p.21

steps.title: Let the slide run forward
steps.action: Retract the slide slightly and release it.
steps.prose: That short pull drops the slide stop out of the way.
steps.quote: This will disengage the slide stop and allow the slide to move fully forward.
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 4, p.22

steps.title: Retract 3/16 inch — not 1/16
steps.action: Retract the slide approximately 3/16 inch until the takedown pin aligns with the cutout in the slide, then pry the pin loose with a non-marring armorer’s tool or other flat, blunt tool.
steps.prose: This is the number that differs from the Security-9. Line the pin up with the cutout and it lifts; guess the distance and it will not.
steps.caution: Be careful not to scratch the slide.
steps.quote: Retract the slide approximately 3/16" until the takedown pin aligns with the cutout in the slide.
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 5, p.22

steps.title: Takedown pin out
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 6, p.23

steps.title: Slide assembly off
steps.action: Move the slide assembly forward and separate it from the grip frame.
steps.quote: Move the slide assembly forward and separate it from the grip frame
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 7, p.23

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly to disengage it from its seat against the barrel lug, then remove it completely.
steps.prose: Under tension against the lug — control it.
steps.caution: Spring under tension. Keep it pointed away from your face.
steps.quote: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly to disengage it from its seat against the barrel lug, and remove it completely
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 8, p.23

steps.title: Barrel out
steps.action: Move the barrel forward slightly, then down and back, to extract it from the slide.
steps.quote: It will be necessary to move the barrel forward slightly and then down and back to extract it from the slide
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 9, p.23

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, magazine.
steps.prose: The manual stops here and so does this guide.
steps.quote: The pistol is now disassembled for cleaning
steps.cite: Ruger Security-380 Lite Rack Instruction Manual — PM1186 — Disassembly, step 10, p.24

deepAbsentReason: PM1186 ends its disassembly at step 10, "The pistol is now disassembled for cleaning" (p.24). Nothing past the field strip is documented, so this listing has NO deep clean.
reassembly: Be certain the chamber and magazine are empty.
Replace the barrel in the slide, then seat the recoil spring assembly against the barrel lug.
Run the slide assembly onto the grip frame and reinstall the takedown pin.
fncheck: Function-check per the manual, pointed in a safe direction with the pistol and magazine confirmed empty.
